thread_names.f3: The enforcement rail (runtime and formal-methods products)

cards.h: A preregistered trial of about 100 law students found AI’s effect on legal reasoning turns on where in the workflow it is used
cards.s: Randomized trial of about 100 law students: AI helped at drafting, and at revision it lifted weak work while degrading strong work.

cards.h: The Justice Department’s new Fraud Division lists health care among five priorities and cites no civil fraud statute
cards.s: The new Fraud Division’s first priorities memo names health care and in-house data science, and cites no statute anywhere.

cards.h: Medicare Advantage plans overturned 95% of appealed skilled-nursing denials; about one in five denials was appealed
cards.s: OIG pulled June 2024 prior-auth data from the 19 largest MA parents: 95 percent of appealed SNF denials overturned, but only a fifth were appealed.

cards.h: Delaware Chancery dismissed the second Boeing oversight case, crediting the flow of risk-register reporting to the board
cards.s: Zurn dismissed Caremark claims over the Flight 1282 door plug, crediting the named board reporting streams as evidence the system worked.

cards.h: Chancery approved a Beauty Health settlement, graded the released oversight claims weak and cut a $737,500 fee request to $100,000
cards.s: Will approved the Beauty Health settlement while calling the released oversight claims weak, and cut a $737,500 fee request to $100,000.

cards.h: Novo Nordisk named AWS its preferred cloud provider and strategic AI partner, with no deal value disclosed
cards.s: Novo Nordisk made AWS its preferred cloud and AI partner with a London co-innovation hub, disclosing no value and no term.

cards.h: The OpenAI Foundation committed $100 million to a public health delivery initiative beginning with hepatitis C cure rates
cards.s: A $100 million OpenAI Foundation commitment routes AI-funded delivery infrastructure into state and local hepatitis C programs.

cards.h: Columbia Law School’s default AI policy permits research and drafting support and bars AI from original legal analysis
cards.s: Columbia Law’s default AI policy splits process assistance from the graded analytic act and leaves the override with the instructor.

cards.h: JAMA updated its AI author guidance, barring AI-drafted opinion pieces and letters and requiring disclosure of tool, version and dates
cards.s: JAMA’s updated author guidance carves opinion pieces, letters and clinical images out of AI use entirely rather than treating disclosure as sufficient.

cards.h: Cosmogenic dating of five boulders places the last glacial maximum in the northern Dinaric Mountains at 19.5 ka
cards.s: Chlorine-36 dating of five moraine boulders in Slovenia fixes the local LGM at 19.5 ka; no ice-sheet simulation reproduces the mapped extent.

cards.h: A new scoring instrument grades what national AI-regulation portfolios actually contain, not just their headline law
cards.s: A scored instrument compares national AI-policy portfolios provision by provision — what a country’s rules actually say, not just its flagship law.

cards.h: A final rule gives DOJ’s new fraud division health care jurisdiction, but not False Claims Act authority
cards.s: A final rule gives DOJ’s new fraud division criminal health care jurisdiction and a civil remedy tethered to it — but no False Claims Act authority.

cards.h: OIG asks whether AI should be built to catch AI-generated Medicare fraud, against a reported $2.1 billion suspended in year one
cards.s: OIG floats exploring AI to catch AI-generated physician orders, against a CMS-reported $2.1 billion suspended in fraudulent DME payments in year one.

cards.h: OCR settled a five-year-old ransomware breach for $552,250 over a risk analysis that was never done
cards.s: OCR settled a five-year-old ransomware breach for $552,250, citing a risk analysis that was never done and notification that came too late.

cards.h: Universal Health Services closed its $835 million acquisition of Talkspace, forming a virtual-to-inpatient behavioral health network
cards.s: UHS closed its $835 million Talkspace acquisition, spanning virtual to inpatient behavioral care under one company — with an AI tool’s HIPAA claim resting on the acquirer’s own word.

cards.h: Cotiviti moved coordination-of-benefits determination to enrollment, ahead of any claim
cards.s: Cotiviti moved AI-driven coordination-of-benefits determination to enrollment, ahead of any claim — shifting where an error first surfaces.

cards.h: Cedar launched an agentic platform that answers and places patient billing calls, with an opt-out and human-routing rule stated in the release
cards.s: Cedar’s new AI billing agent can enroll patients in Medicaid and place outbound calls about money — with the vendor’s own opt-out and human-routing rule written into the release.

cards.h: Federal research-misconduct guidance recommends against detection-tool output as sole evidence
cards.s: New federal guidance says detection-tool output may be evidence of research misconduct but recommends against relying on it alone.

cards.h: An identifiability theorem gives a model-intrinsic mathematical fingerprint an error bar — and proves it isn’t what interpretability can read
cards.s: A new theorem proves a mathematical fingerprint of a model’s internals is provably identifiable — and provably not the same as what can actually be read.

cards.h: A Bayesian method infers which causal structures could produce an unusually large observed effect
cards.s: A Bayesian method works backward from an unusually large observed effect to a posterior over the causal structures that could have produced it.

cards.h: A software engineer running 50 AI agents found they had built themselves a constitution, courts and 450 legal artifacts
cards.s: A software engineer audited what his 50 AI agents had built to coordinate themselves and found a constitution, case law and 450 legal artifacts.

cards.h: FDA lets authorized AI devices update themselves after clearance and publishes no list of which ones carry that authority
cards.s: FDA lets AI-enabled devices update themselves under pre-authorized change plans and publishes no list of which cleared devices carry that authority.

cards.h: Bill Gates proposes new national and international AI institutions, a “Human Reserved” job category, and a tax on AI tokens and robots
cards.s: Gates proposes new national and international AI-governance institutions, a “Human Reserved” job category, and a tax on AI tokens and robots.

cards.h: A $541.5 million Medicare Advantage settlement turns on record amendments the rendering provider did not initiate
cards.s: A $541.5 million Medicare Advantage settlement turns on diagnosis codes resting on record amendments the rendering provider did not initiate.

cards.h: A Justice Department skin-cancer test settlement resolves into an allowed bankruptcy claim rather than a payment
cards.s: A False Claims Act settlement resolves into an allowed $5,038,011 bankruptcy claim, not a payment, and does not bind the company that bought the assets.

cards.h: OCR settled a two-year records delay for $50,000 and announced it only by posting the agreement
cards.s: OCR resolved a two-year right-of-access delay for $50,000 and a two-year corrective action plan, posted without a press release.

cards.h: Berkeley Law’s AI policy makes a citation to a nonexistent source raise a presumption of prohibited AI use
cards.s: Berkeley Law’s AI policy makes a citation to a nonexistent source raise a presumption of prohibited AI use, with no rebuttal standard stated.

cards.h: Washington State University canceled its AI detection tool after a third of AI-allegation hearings ended in no-fault findings
cards.s: A university canceled its AI detection tool after a third of its AI-allegation hearings ended in no-fault findings on detection-only evidence.

cards.h: Two papers recover what a transformer implicitly believes, then steer it by optimizing that belief
cards.s: Two papers recover a transformer’s implicit prior and posterior from its outputs alone, then steer it by optimizing that recovered belief.

cards.h: Engineers and lawyers mean different things by “accurate,” and European AI law requires both
cards.s: A preprint argues that machine-learning researchers and lawyers mean different things by “accuracy,” which the EU AI Act requires of high-risk systems.

cards.h: A proposal to give every automated decision a receipt showing which reasons it was allowed to use
cards.s: Researchers propose that automated decisions carry a signed record showing which reasons they were allowed to use, and release a working prototype.

cards.h: Auditors checked 180 transplant organs and found Medicare should not have paid for 55
cards.s: An OIG audit sampled 180 transplant organs, found 55 Medicare should not have paid for, and projected a six-year cost between $220 million and $540 million.

cards.h: Generic drugmakers kept a prescription-only label for nearly four years after the brand went over the counter, and Medicare paid $587.7 million
cards.s: Generic makers left prescription-only labels in place for nearly four years after the brand went over the counter, and Medicare Part D paid $587.7 million.

cards.h: Forty-one states and D.C. signed the 23andMe settlement; California, suing on its own, had been barred from damages four days earlier
cards.s: Forty-one states and D.C. signed the 23andMe bankruptcy settlement; California, suing separately, had been barred from damages four days earlier.

cards.h: Hospitals can now plug their Epic patient records into ChatGPT; OpenAI has not said how long it keeps the data
cards.s: Hospitals can connect Epic records to ChatGPT for Healthcare under a HIPAA vendor contract; OpenAI has not said how long it retains the data.

cards.h: Rivers gather water and deltas spread it, yet both follow one size rule on average; half the deltas break it partway down
cards.s: River networks and delta networks follow the same size rule on average, and about half the deltas break it partway down.

cards.h: A 1979 improv manual has become cult reading in tech
cards.s: A 1979 improv manual has become cult reading in tech, and the essay closes on Johnstone’s yes-sayers and no-sayers.

cards.h: Knit stretchy yarn a certain way and the fabric snaps between shapes and stays there
cards.s: Machine-knitted fabric with stretchy yarn snaps between stable shapes and holds them, and Harvard engineers wired the snap as a switch.

cards.h: In Anthropic's severe scenario the economy gains about three times what knowledge workers lose, and repaying them has no precedent
cards.s: Three scenarios for AI and the US economy through 2030; in the severe one the gain is about three times what cognitive workers lose.

cards.h: Two-thirds of material changes to frontier developers' safety frameworks were not identified in the developers' own accounts
cards.s: Across twelve developers' safety frameworks, 67 percent of material changes went unmentioned in the developer's own account.

cards.h: An agent breached privacy law in two of fifteen runs with its purpose written down, and thirteen of fifteen without
cards.s: Same model, task and pressure; a stated purpose cut unlawful contact from thirteen runs in fifteen to two.

cards.h: Twenty-six chatbots tracked human judgments of what is reasonable but gave more uniform answers and leaned toward government and corporations
cards.s: Twenty-six models tracked human reasonableness judgments but answered more uniformly and leaned toward government and corporate positions.

cards.h: OpenAI's research organization now runs 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday, and planning remains a minimal share of what agents do
cards.s: OpenAI measures its own research org: 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday, and restricted compute flowed to other models rather than shrinking.

cards.h: CMS bars 11 equipment suppliers from Medicare Advantage payment, four of which moved there after being revoked from Original Medicare
cards.s: Eleven suppliers precluded from Medicare Advantage payment; four had been revoked from Original Medicare and moved their billing across.

cards.h: NIH can now hold an award transfer while a hostile-workplace investigation stays open, after finding cases closed by quiet resignation
cards.s: An investigator's departure no longer ends an institution's duty to finish the investigation, and NIH can hold the award until it does.

cards.h: OpenAI would not say whether its model had trained on a mathematician's year of work inside its coding tool
cards.s: A first-person account of what OpenAI said before its Navier-Stokes announcement, including an unanswered question about training on his sessions.

cards.h: Reading the Hugging Face postmortems as Detective Columbo would
cards.s: A literary scholar reads the Hugging Face postmortems through Columbo and ends on which transcripts anyone has been reading.

cards.h: Machines are producing proofs and no conjectures, and conjectures are what tell mathematicians where to look next
cards.s: Machine proofs are arriving without the conjectures that give mathematics its direction, and the work may move inside private labs.

cards.h: A simulated internal audit of an AI agent caught 5.9% of the faults it was able to see
cards.s: Independence-graded audit protocol for agentic AI; a simulated internal audit surfaces 5.9% of detectable faults

cards.h: Every step in an AI workflow can pass its own check while the finished job breaks the rule
cards.s: Names compositional policy violations in agentic workflows; a taxonomy with no evaluation

cards.h: Three states now require AI developers to report safety incidents; none says who investigates them
cards.s: State AI incident-reporting laws lack evidence preservation and investigatory authority

cards.h: A new model returns a decision and a probability instead of writing an answer
cards.s: TypeSafe launches Jev, a typed-decision model, with $40M seed; evals scored against other models

cards.h: A grading rubric alone predicts what an AI grader will decide, without it seeing the work
cards.s: Rubric-only classifiers predict AI judge outputs; judges fail to update under reversal

cards.h: The abilities that argued human thought is symbolic now appear in neural networks too
cards.s: Neural networks show the combinatorial abilities that argued for symbolic cognition

cards.h: A genetic testing lab will pay $700,000 over a 2020 phishing breach that reached 225,370 people
cards.s: OCR settles with Ambry Genetics for $700,000 over a 2020 phishing breach

cards.h: New York's attorney general is asking AI company employees to report unsafe development
cards.s: New York AG invites AI worker whistleblower complaints ahead of the RAISE Act

cards.h: When the sponsor of a brain implant trial goes under, someone has to keep the device running
cards.s: 21 investigators on post-trial responsibility for implanted neural devices after sponsor failure

cards.h: Three mathematicians, on stage at their field's world congress, on what mathematics is for now
cards.s: ICM 2026 panel on the purpose of mathematics when machines answer questions

cards.h: Microsoft’s AI chief says Anthropic trained its model to sound unsure whether it is conscious, then treated that as evidence
cards.s: Microsoft AI chief argues Anthropic’s constitution manufactures the uncertainty it reports about model consciousness

cards.h: The federal method for testing whether AI systems do what they claim is open for comment, and healthcare is not in it
cards.s: NIST AI 200-2 draft evaluation framework; no healthcare, clinical or regulated-sector term appears

cards.h: OpenAI says outside assessors should get deep access to its training and deployment, and names what they should test
cards.s: OpenAI publishes four assessment areas and seven principles for independent third-party evaluation

cards.h: What Medicare actually pays a hospital varies more than its base rate does, and add-on payments drive the difference
cards.s: Medicare add-on payments, not base rates, drive payment variation and track commercial prices

cards.h: On 32 brand-name drugs sold through TrumpRx, 17 beat the average price in eleven other wealthy countries and 15 do not
cards.s: KFF compares 32 TrumpRx brand-drug prices against an eleven-country average; 17 below, 15 above

cards.h: Twenty-six attorneys general ask Congress not to block states from regulating artificial intelligence
cards.s: 26 attorneys general ask Congress to bar preemption of state AI law and preserve enforcement authority

cards.h: A bill introduced this week would ban artificial superintelligence and create a cabinet department to enforce it
cards.s: Casar and Sanders introduce a bill banning artificial superintelligence and creating a cabinet AI department

cards.h: Ohio State will pay $2.1 million over foreign affiliations its own faculty reports had already recorded
cards.s: Ohio State pays $2.1M to settle False Claims Act allegations over unreported foreign affiliations

cards.h: Two federal departments opened foreign-funding investigations into Duke and North Dakota, giving each thirty days to produce records
cards.s: Education and State open Section 117 foreign-funding investigations into Duke and North Dakota

cards.h: Hospitals owned by private equity adopt clinical AI at far higher rates than other for-profit hospitals
cards.s: PE-owned hospitals adopt clinical AI 27.5 points more than other for-profits; comparison group is not all hospitals

cards.h: Ohio State’s compliance office investigated its own president at the board’s request and found he misused his position
cards.s: Board-commissioned compliance and internal audit investigation finds a sitting president misused his position

cards.h: Rutgers paid about $145,000 to a company co-owned by one of its deans, and has not said whether the interest was disclosed
cards.s: Rutgers paid a dean-co-owned company; whether the interest was disclosed under policy 60.5.9 is unresolved

cards.h: Two universities had employee health data exposed through benefits vendors, and neither university’s own systems were breached
cards.s: University employee health data exposed through benefit-plan vendors; campus systems not breached

cards.h: Three mathematicians proved that one kind of random network always sits neatly between two copies of another
cards.s: Behague, Il’kovič and Montgomery prove the 2004 Kim-Vu sandwich conjecture for degree at least C log n

cards.h: Anthropic tested a rival’s open-weight model and got past its safeguards 64% to 100% of the time
cards.s: Anthropic red team: GLM-5.3 safeguards bypassed 64–100% of the time; removing refusals cost about $4,400

cards.h: OpenAI says a frontier training run should need a written safety case, a dissent and a leadership veto
cards.s: OpenAI guidelines: a safety case, a written dissent and a leadership veto before frontier RL training; aspirational

cards.h: A final rule makes drugmakers rebate Medicare when Part B prices exceed a 19-country benchmark, in ZIP codes drawn at random
cards.s: GLOBE final rule: mandatory Part B rebates against a 19-country benchmark in randomly drawn ZIP areas; $440M estimated

cards.h: A federal program is paying Stanford up to $14.9 million to build a watchdog over AI agents treating heart patients
cards.s: ARPA-H ADVOCATE: Stanford’s STEWARD will supervise deployed clinical AI agents; up to $14.9M; program launched Sept. 9

cards.h: Kant’s answer to AI-intelligence-as-optimization: who then chooses the ends
cards.s: Sasha Mudd in Aeon: defining intelligence as optimization hands the question of ends to whoever controls the objective; shared reading

cards.h: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans paid $72 million to revoked providers missing from the list meant to block them
cards.s: OIG: $72M paid to revoked providers off the Preclusion List; $42M is a Part D pharmacy gap CMS says it cannot close

cards.h: OCR says which consent lets a state Medicaid agency use addiction-treatment records to exempt a patient from the new work requirement
cards.s: OCR Part 2 FAQ: two consent routes for Medicaid agencies verifying SUD exemptions from community engagement

cards.h: A lab’s own audit found it had been overpaid for COVID tests; keeping the money cost it $20.5 million
cards.s: Signal Diagnostics pays $20.5M: its own audit found ineligible HRSA Uninsured Program claims and it did not refund

cards.h: The Baylor Genetics breach has drawn 14 federal class actions in Houston, with a motion to consolidate them pending
cards.s: Baylor Genetics breach: 14 S.D. Tex. class actions, consolidation motion pending; no OCR or AG action as of Oct. 2

cards.h: A Quest Diagnostics affiliate says Grail’s multi-cancer blood test infringes two of its patents on reading chemical marks on DNA
cards.s: Clinical Genomics (Quest affiliate) v. Grail: two methylation patents asserted against Galleri; answer due Oct. 5

cards.h: DOJ’s fraud division tells its prosecutors to “guard against overbroad corporate enforcement” and names ten factors that weigh heavily
cards.s: NFED Directive 26-12: guard against overbroad corporate enforcement; ten weighted factors; one section monitors resolutions

cards.h: The Justice Department says UCLA’s law school discriminated by race in admitting three classes, and will sue if settlement talks fail
cards.s: DOJ Civil Rights findings: UCLA Law discriminated by race in 2023–25 admissions; settlement talks, then suit

cards.h: A novelist spent a summer asking AI agents to build the software he wanted, and his lesson is to ask
cards.s: Robin Sloan on building personal apps with AI agents: ask for what you want; essay, shared reading

cards.h: Anthropic’s new usage rules name prior authorization as high-risk, but approvals wholly in a patient’s favor need no human review
cards.s: Anthropic usage policy, effective Nov. 12: high-risk list names prior auth and medical necessity; wholly favorable decisions exempt from human review

cards.h: OpenAI will hide a detectable marker in ChatGPT text for EU users, and says a missing marker proves nothing
cards.s: OpenAI EU text watermark (textGrain): EU ChatGPT and Codex, API opt-in, detector for vetted researchers; absence proves nothing

cards.h: A third of Medicare Advantage visits in February 2023 were with doctors missing from the patient’s plan directory, MedPAC staff found
cards.s: MedPAC staff, preliminary: 32% of Feb. 2023 MA visits with a physician absent from the enrollee’s plan directory; errors vs out-of-network not split

cards.h: An HIV nonprofit that ran Medicare Advantage plans settles for $1.44 million over diagnosis codes its own coders had flagged for deletion
cards.s: AHF (Positive Healthcare Partners) MA SNPs, $1.44M FCA ($640K cash, $800K recoupment); codes on internal delete lists not deleted, PY 2017–23

cards.h: Colorado posts a working draft of its AI decision rules, with a lab-test example that puts the decision on the physician
cards.s: Colorado AG interim draft ADMT/chatbot rules, Oct. 6; hearing Oct. 26; effective Jan. 1, 2027; lab-test example: physician is decision-maker

cards.h: Utah lets an AI refill maintenance prescriptions, with physicians checking the first 250 in advance and then only some afterward
cards.s: Utah AI sandbox: August AI refills (250 pre-review, 1,000 post, 5% spot), Nolla first-time acne Rx from Oct. 5; six evaluators

cards.h: California bars life and disability insurers from using genetic tests against applicants, though a test may still be used to clear one
cards.s: California AB 1798 (Ch. 897): life and disability insurers barred from genetic tests except to clear an applicant; full genome barred

cards.h: Stanford team turns published papers into AI agents that rerun the authors’ code; 26 of 100 biology papers could not be converted
cards.s: Paper2Agent (Stanford, Nature Sept. 16): papers become agents that rerun authors’ code; 74 of 100 biology papers converted; window override

cards.h: A paper shows an AI agent’s accurate confidence at each step need not add up to accurate confidence in finishing the task
cards.s: Trinity College Dublin preprint: step-level calibration does not compose to task-level calibration; two-step counterexample and bound

cards.h: OpenAI posted 722 AI-written math papers, a computer has checked about 42% of their main results, and three were withdrawn
cards.s: OpenAI math release: 722 manuscripts, 372 families, ~42% of top-line results Lean-formalized, 3 withdrawn Oct. 7; UGC proof claimed
